text: O you who have believed in Allah as Lord, in Muhammad as Prophet and Messenger, and in Islam as religion, enter into all the laws of Islam, acting upon all its rulings, and do not leave any of them, and do not follow the paths of Satan in what he calls you to of disobedience. Indeed, he is to you an enemy with manifest enmity, so beware of him.
